mcqs.question: Over the past several decades, scientists have observed large, continental-scale shifts in the migratory routes and destinations of many long-distance migratory bird species in North America and Europe. options.B: Low-frequency (50–60 Hz) electromagnetic fields from expanding urban power grids, which slightly skew birds' magnetic sense of north and cause a small but consistent navigational error that compounds over thousands of kilometers.
